midheaven.conjunction: Your outward manner and your public direction are the same thing, so what people see is exactly what you are aiming at.
midheaven.harmonious: How you come across and where you are going support each other, so making an impression and making progress are one activity.
midheaven.square: The way you present yourself works against your ambitions, and you have been underestimated by people who mattered.
midheaven.opposition: Your bearing and your reputation tell different stories, and people who know you socially are surprised by what you do.
